notes: Haight, Turrill and Cherry are printed bare ('HAIGHT', 'TURRILL', 'CHERRY'); written as Haight Avenue, Turrill Street, Cherry Street. Hamilton Avenue (60') is straight across the whole sheet (no bend at Pullan) and runs off the top edge and on south of Chase. Cherry/Pullan is not recorded: on this sheet only Cherry's east face reaches Pullan at the left paper edge and its centreline meets Pullan west of the paper (sheet 631 has it). Cherry/Chase is drawn as a T here (the south face of Chase, outline of sheet 622, runs unbroken across Cherry's mouth), although the key map shows Cherry continuing south into sheet 622; Turrill and Hamilton visibly continue south of Chase (gaps in the south face), Brookside ends at Chase. Thomson Avenue here is the short 30' street between Hamilton and Brookside south of the Cumminsville Presbyterian church (not the Thomson Avenue near Glenparker on the key map); it ends at Brookside's east face (blank on this sheet). Alley 1: unnamed 15' alley (15' printed at both ends) from Cherry to Turrill north of the engine house lot (faces y~6431/6522 at x 450, 6448/6538 at x 1500); it stops at Turrill. Alley 2: unnamed narrow passage (~12', no width printed) leaving the south side of Chase at x~5190-5260 and running SSE off the bottom edge into sheet 623/633; line given from the Chase centreline to the paper edge. Pullan is straight from the left edge to the right edge; Brookside's east side and the block north of Pullan east of Haight continue on sheets 633/635.
